incident_analysis.root_cause: TLS handshake failure caused by outdated OpenSSL 1.1.1w package attempting deprecated protocols and vulnerable to remote code execution (CVE-2026-4019).

remediation_plan.immediate_action: Execute: sudo apt update && sudo apt install --only-upgrade openssl nginx to install the latest patched packages.
remediation_plan.configuration_change: Update /etc/nginx/nginx.conf to enforce: ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; and disable legacy SSLv3/TLS1.0/1.1.
remediation_plan.post_check_command: sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx && openssl s_client -connect localhost:443 -tls1_3
